title: Enhancemize
description: A modpack that enhances your gameplay with QoL mods and optimizes your minecraft experience
body:
![Enhancemize modpack banner showing performance and quality-of-life features](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_75ec8a50-5594-4cdc-8bbe-7bbb90b73fdd.png) **Enhancemize – A Minecraft modpack focused on performance and small gameplay improvements.** *** **Performance** Enhancemize dramatically improves Minecraft’s performance using modern optimization mods (if compatible). **Enhancements** In addition to performance, Enhancemize adds some enhancements that make will the gameplay smoother and more responsive, including a minimap and much more. **Feels familiar** The modpack maintains Minecraft’s classic experience. You can play in singleplayer or multiplayer, and enjoy all your favorite vanilla features without compromise. **Works everywhere** No content mods are included, so you can play on any world or server. The modpack is fully client-side and may be compatible with vanilla servers, ensuring maximum flexibility. **Up to date** Enhancemize is regularly updated to support the latest Minecraft versions, making it easy to stay current while preserving your mod settings whenever possible. **Built on Fabric** The modpack uses the lightweight Fabric mod loader, giving fast startup times and broad mod compatibility.
